shape: Irregular dual-chamber with central hinge + west pocket (N+S gates)
description: Two main combat chambers (south chamber Z≈3–17, north chamber Z≈-14 to -25) connected by a central hinge anchor (23z008) at Z≈-5. The south chamber has its own internal staging (south_hub plus a south-mid hub) covering two east-side corners. The north chamber routes via a west-middle hub that also branches to a small west pocket dead-end. Hinge is the only point connecting the two chambers; west pocket is a single-anchor detour off the west-middle hub.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-5.94, 25.43) — gate on the south (high-Z) end of the south chamber
portals.north: spawn_north at (-6.14, -24.62) — gate on the north (low-Z) end of the north chamber

anchors.description: central hinge — single connection point between south and north chambers (matches 23z008)
north chamber entry hub, joins north_gate (matches qqqnv9)

traversalNotes: Direct N↔S backbone: spawn_south → south_hub → south_mid → central_hinge → north_hub → spawn_north (alt via west_mid). Six hops.

DISPATCH RULE: corner objectives route via the same-chamber staging hub. south_ne / south_se → via south_hub or south_mid (both clique into the south chamber). north_ne → via north_hub or west_mid. Don't cross the central_hinge for a same-chamber objective.
WEST POCKET (west_pocket) is the only single-degree dead-end — purely a detour off west_mid, likely home to an in-cell objective. Routing: backbone → west_mid → west_pocket → reverse.
CENTRAL HINGE is the only connection between the two chambers; off-hinge cross-chamber edges are NOT walkable.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
